findings.detail: The shipped gloss makes this a transitive verb of putting fires out, which is löschen (or auslöschen). The strong verb erlöschen (erlischt, erlosch, ist erloschen) is intransitive: a flame or light goes out on its own (die Kerze erlosch), and by extension a right, warranty, contract, or family line lapses or dies out (der Anspruch erlischt). candidate_glosses offers only the transitive reading, so the correct sense is not in the list — this is a wrong-entry import rather than a wrong-index one. A learner taught 'extinguish' will write ich erlösche das Feuer, which is not German.

'determine through advice or empathy' is an archaic sense preserved from the older meaning of raten (advise), and as English it barely reads as a verb meaning at all. The verb a learner meets is 'guess correctly' — Rate mal! … Du hast es erraten! — which is candidate_glosses index 1, 'to guess (something) correctly, to divine'. The importer took kaikki's first-listed sense over the only living one.

'grow up' is what aufwachsen means, and it is almost certainly first in kaikki because the participle erwachsen became the adjective for 'adult'. As a finite verb in modern German, erwachsen means to arise or spring from something: daraus erwuchsen erhebliche Probleme, ihm erwuchs daraus ein Vorteil. That is candidate_glosses index 1 ('to spring up, to spring from, to proceed from') and index 4 ('to arise (difficulties, tasks)'). A learner given 'grow up' will reach for erwachsen where only aufwachsen works.

Plain 'die' of a person or animal is sterben; ersterben is not used that way in modern German. It survives almost exclusively in the figurative sense of a sound, motion, or expression fading out — der Lärm erstarb, das Lächeln erstarb auf ihren Lippen. That is candidate_glosses index 1, 'to die away, to gradually stop'. The shipped gloss both duplicates sterben and sends the learner to the wrong register.

The comma presents 'reimburse' and 'file' as synonyms, but they are two unrelated senses, and 'file' is uninterpretable on its own: it is a fragment of the fixed collocation Anzeige erstatten (file a complaint) / Bericht erstatten (make a report), where the meaning lives in the noun. Keeping 'reimburse' — the sense that works with a free object, as in Kosten erstatten — and dropping the stranded fragment.

kaikki's bare 'to learn' loses what distinguishes this verb: ersehen is nearly always aus etwas ersehen, to gather or discern something from a document or set of facts (wie aus dem Bericht zu ersehen ist). As shipped it collides head-on with lernen and with erlernen, which this same corpus glosses 'learn, acquire', so the learner has no way to tell the three apart.
